review_notes: Precision review used only the Doc27 Raw + components raw schematic and overlay/crops as visual sources, plus Diego round 1 JSON/CSV as the proposal under review; no GT, Raw+wires, or OCR engines were used.

Most repeated 480 V load-center branch chains are retained because each asserted edge follows visible direct vertical adjacency through the breaker/disconnect/fuse/load and then the visible dashed or dotted endpoint line.
No direct bus-to-bus shortcut is asserted across CB-TIE-41; only the tie breaker component is adjacent to each 4.16 kV bus side.
The A-side charger/battery branch remains asserted through CB-A10, DS-A10, BAT-125A, JB-A10, and DC-BUS-125A where solid conductors are visible.
Removed the B-side BAT-125B to DC-BUS-125B asserted edge because the raw crop does not show BAT-125B terminating on the DC-BUS-125B tap; that relationship is kept as uncertain rather than guessed.
Ground/DC-ground candidates are treated separately from ordinary bus ties; only the visible equipment-ground drops from BUS-480-C and BUS-480-D to their ground symbols remain asserted.
